2609.22375.title: Initial Evaluation of Potential Bias in Coverage of Humans in Wikidata
2609.22375.paper_summary: Introduction. Open collaborative knowledge graphs such as Wikidata increasingly ground agentic artificial intelligence, information retrieval, and language modeling systems, making systematic auditing of their demographic representation and overall equity a research imperative. Methods. Herein, we present an open-source auditing platform that ingests over 10 million statement bindings representing over 6 million humans on Wikidata via QLever, and evaluates representation of gender, sexual orientation, geography, birthplace urbanicity, ethnicity, multilingual coverage of labels, descriptions, and aliases, occupation, and select intersectional pairs of these entities. It does so by making use of Chi-square goodness-of-fit tests, 95% Wilson-score confidence intervals, and disparity ratios, in light of Rubin's missingness taxonomy. Results. Women accounted for 28.71% (CI +/-0.04) of all humans in Wikidata with a stated gender. 38.26% of humans had a citizenship statement, with Western Europe and North America (WENA) representing approximately 53% of such statements. Among 1.8 million birthplaces that could be classified, rural birthplaces were observed in 2.48% of cases (in comparison to 27.4% global baseline). Fewer than 1.2% of entities carried an ethnicity statement, and non-English Wikidata descriptions covered 18.2% of items. Discussion. Our findings reveal significant missingness across the evaluated axes. Ethnicity and sexual orientation were the most critically under-documented (missing statements) while rural birthplaces and non-WENA citizenship were the most underrepresented.
2609.22375.paper_summary_zh: 引言。開放協作知識圖譜，如Wikidata，越來越多地支持代理型人工智慧、信息檢索和語言建模系統，使得對其人口統計代表性和整體公平性的系統性審核成為一項研究的必要。方法。在此，我們提出了一個開源審核平台，通過QLever攝取超過1000萬條聲明綁定，代表Wikidata上超過600萬人，並評估性別、性取向、地理位置、出生地城市化、族裔、標籤、描述和別名的多語言覆蓋、職業以及這些實體的選定交叉對的代表性。它通過利用卡方適合度檢驗、95%威爾遜分數置信區間和差異比率，根據Rubin的缺失性分類進行。結果。女性在Wikidata中佔有聲明性別的所有人類的28.71%（CI +/-0.04）。38.26%的人類有國籍聲明，其中西歐和北美（WENA）約佔此類聲明的53%。在180萬個可以分類的出生地中，鄉村出生地在2.48%的案例中被觀察到（相比於27.4%的全球基線）。少於1.2%的實體有族裔聲明，且非英語的Wikidata描述涵蓋了18.2%的項目。討論。我們的發現揭示了在評估的軸上存在顯著的缺失性。族裔和性取向是最為關鍵的低記錄（缺失聲明），而鄉村出生地和非WENA國籍則是最被低估的。
